text:
Maria K: Quick thread to pin down final copy and lead routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing updates. Need final hero + 1 subhead + CTA per page.
Jon P: I'll start with a recommended compare strip: one-liner each, highlight the core buyer and primary metric to care about. Drafting now.
Priya S: For Hosted hero option A: `Build LLM features fast. Start with free credits.` Option B: `Production-ready API for text, chat, and embeddings.`
Noor L: For Dedicated variants: A: `Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput.` B: `Dedicated pools, enterprise SLAs, predictable pricing.`
Leo G: Private page: A: `Bring inference behind your VPC or on-prem.` B: `Private deployments with KMS/HSM + audit logs.`
Maria K: Good. Keep Hosted wording product-led, Dedicated more procurement-friendly, Private security-first.
Jon P: CTA mapping proposal: Hosted => `Try Hosted`, form minimal (email + company). Dedicated => `Request capacity quote` (longer form). Private => `Schedule private demo`.
Priya S: Webinar blurb we can use in a secondary module: `Webinar: Reduce inference costs without sacrificing latency. Live Q&A + 2 customer case studies.` CTA: `Register`.
Noor L: Lead routing rules: If registration form includes "Interested in Dedicated/Private" checkbox then route to SDRs team_queue=enterprise, set lead_priority:high. Otherwise auto-send Hosted welcome flow via product-nurture.
Leo G: I'll add URL param utm_campaign=landing_q2_2026 and `?variant=heroA` so we can A/B measure. Please use `landing_engagement=hero_cta` as an event label in GA.
Maria K: Copyguard: don't publish latency or $ numbers on the page unless we have signoff from eng and benching team. Use qualitative claims like "latency-optimized" or "low-latency p50" with p50 wording if we include a number.
Jon P: Agreed. If we include a numeric callout, we'll source it from eng (Ashwin) and cite the test conditions.
Priya S: Small microcopy for the Dedicated bullets (three): "Autoscale and burst", "SLA-backed latency", "Isolated customer data". Keep short and scannable.
Noor L: For the Hosted hero subhead: maybe "Pay-as-you-go API + streaming and function calling" to surface features without long lists.
Leo G: For the compare strip, propose this layout: Hosted — Developer-first, low friction; Dedicated — Predictable throughput, reserved GPU; Private — Regulated workloads, on-prem/VPC.
Maria K: Routing details: Leo, after form submission set a hidden field lead_origin=landing and add `lead_tags: ["webinar_reg","landing_cta"]`. SDRs will get an email digest every morning for enterprise leads.
Noor L: Also add a small checkbox on webinar form: "Share my company details with sales for a follow-up" — if checked, mark lead_sales_optin=true.
Jon P: I'll upload copy variants to the copy board and tag @PriyaS and @NoorL. Please leave in-line comments by EOD.
copybot: Reminder: content freeze for landing pages on 1801008000 per release calendar.
Maria K: Timeline: finalize copy choices tomorrow morning 10:30 review, implement by Friday slot, QA next week. Thanks team.
